data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long term capital appreciation by investing in a diversiﬁed portfolio ofequity & equity related instruments across large cap, mid cap and small cap stocks. There is no assurance that the investmentobjective of the Scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments : 75-100%, Large Cap Companies*: 25-50%; Mid Cap Companies*: 25-50%; Small CapCompanies*: 25-50%; Debt and Money Market Instruments including Tri party Repo: 0-25%; Units issued by InfrastructureInvestment Trusts (InvITs): 0-10%. *Deﬁnition of Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap: As per Paragraph 2.7 of SEBI Master Circularfor Mutual Funds, a deﬁnition has been provided of large cap, mid cap and small cap as follows. a) Large Cap: 1st - 100thCompany in terms of full market capitalization b) Mid Cap: 101st - 250th Company in terms of full market capitalization c) SmallCap: 251st Company onwards in terms of full market capitalization. Please refer the Scheme Information Document forcomplete details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1: Mr. Dikshit Mittal ; FM 2: Mr. Yogesh Patil
data.exit_load: 12% of the units allotted shall be redeemed or switched out without any exit load, on or before completion of 12 months fromthe date of allotment of units., 1% on remaining units if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 12 months fromthe date of allotment of units, Nil, if redeemed or switched out after completion of 12 months from the date of allotment ofunits.
